levity

LEV-i-tee · noun

Hear It

What It Means

Levity is joking or playful humor at a moment that calls for seriousness.

A single moment of levity from the youngest cousin broke the tense silence at the family dinner table.

Example

The surgeon's brief joke before the operation was meant to relieve the room's tension, but the patient's family found the sudden levity unsettling.

Levity is lightness or humor introduced into a moment that most people expect to stay serious.

Compare the words

Synonyms · words with a similar meaning

flippancy: Flippancy is a casual, disrespectful tone -- answering a serious question with a shrug or a smart remark. Levity is about timing more than tone: even warm, well-meant humor becomes levity when it arrives at a moment that demands seriousness.

frivolity: Frivolity is silliness or wasteful lightness where care was owed -- unserious behavior of any kind, not only jokes. Levity is narrower: specifically humor breaking into a solemn moment. All levity is unserious, but frivolity needs no joke at all.

What it isn’t · antonyms and near-opposites

solemnity: a serious, formal, dignified manner

gravity: extreme seriousness or importance

Where it sits · how badly the humor clashes with seriousness — playfulness → levity → mockery

playfulness vs. levity: Playfulness is a gentle, harmless sense of fun that doesn't necessarily clash with the seriousness of a moment the way levity can.

mockery vs. levity: Mockery goes further than levity, turning lightness into open ridicule of something serious.

Build the Word

The pieces

root — lev-

root — lev-: light (not heavy) (Latin levis)

suffix — -ity

suffix — -ity: state of, quality of (Latin/French)

Put it together

Put it together: Levity comes from Latin levis ('light, not heavy') plus -ity ('state of') -- 'the state of being light,' extended from physical lightness to a lightness of tone or seriousness.

Use the root in a new word: levitate

Use the root in a new word: levitate: Fans still argue about how the magician's levitating cabinet really worked.

Root Check

Word Choice

Levity almost always implies a mismatch -- lightness or humor appearing where the situation calls for seriousness. It carries a hint of surprise or mild disapproval.
